patch.value: Global flags before a subcommand corrupt guided-error command examples by treating the flag value as the command

GitHub issue #984 reproduces on 2026.8.7 and 2026.8.11: pm --pm-path <tracker> plan show --json correctly identifies the missing plan id but renders the global flag value as the command in examples. Guided-error command-path recovery must use parsed command structure, never raw first-non-flag heuristics, for every host-owned global option ordering.

Global options before or after the subcommand produce identical valid help examples; option values and private filesystem paths can never be rendered as command names; focused unit and extension-forwarding regressions cover value-taking and boolean global flags; issue #984 is closed with merged evidence
